description: Recorded IEC 60870-5-101 traffic go-iec60870-5 is tested against (testdata/captures/README.md). Files are byte-identical to their sources.

evidence_levels.C: independent recorded traffic, hardware origin unknown

sources.revision: attachments 17041 and 17042 of bug 15688 (2019-04-09), migrated uploads
sources.terms: Attached to a public Wireshark issue by the reporter; no licence is stated for the attachments. Wireshark itself is GPL-2.0-or-later.
sources.notes: Issue "Add support for IEC 60870-5-101", reported by Chris Bontje, who wrote the IEC 101 dissector and the RTAC serial-line dissector. Both files are SEL RTAC serial-line captures (link type 250).

sources.terms: Attached to a public Wireshark issue by the reporter; no licence is stated for the attachments.
sources.notes: Issue "Dissector IEC 60870-5-101 can not decode some typeid information", reported by João Paulo Rezende with the captures monitor_energisa_1_2020_03_05.pcapng ("typeid 2") and monitor_energisa_2.pcapng ("typeid 30"); iec101.tar.xz holds the same two files and two screenshots and is not committed.

sources.terms: Attached to a public Wireshark issue by a Wireshark developer; no licence is stated for the attachment.
sources.notes: Issue "IEC 60870-5-101 link address field is 1 byte, but should have configurable length": the developer "added the frame of the screenshot" of the reporter, one frame rebuilt from a screenshot.

sources.terms: The repository has no licence file and states no terms.
sources.notes: A tool that cuts an IEC 101 byte stream into packets and writes them as TCP between 192.168.0.1:2424 and 192.168.0.2:1212 with whole-second time stamps and sequence numbers starting at 0 and 1000. test_output.pcap holds no frame and is not committed.

sources.terms: The Wireshark repository is GPL-2.0-or-later; the capture has no statement of its own.
sources.notes: The synthetic capture of the IEC 104 corpus (iec104/testdata/captures/wireshark), not committed twice: its TCP port 2405 carries generated IEC 101 frames.

files.evidence_basis: Generated for Wireshark's dissector tests (commit message); the IEC 104 corpus records it as E too. The frames follow no exchange: responses without requests, FCB not toggled.

files.format: pcap, SEL RTAC serial line (link type 250)
files.evidence_basis: Written by an SEL RTAC's serial-line capture: the frames carry the UART control lines (RTS, CTS, DSR, DTR) of a physical serial port. The RTAC is the controlled station; neither its model and firmware nor the controlling station are stated.
systems: controlling station (not stated) on the RTAC's serial port
SEL RTAC as controlled station, link address 64, common address 64
files.operations: station interrogation (C_IC_NA_1) with confirmation and termination, class 1 and class 2 polls answered with M_SP_TB_1, M_DP_TB_1, M_ST_TB_1, M_ME_TD_1 ("Class 1/2 Scans with Various Info Object Responses")
files.missing_for_verification: the RTAC model and firmware, the controlling station

files.format: pcap, SEL RTAC serial line (link type 250)
files.evidence_basis: Written by an SEL RTAC's serial-line capture with the UART control lines of a physical port. The line is shared: the RTAC (link address 64) also records the polls of link addresses 78, 20 and 57 and the answers of the stations at 78 and 20.
systems: controlling station (not stated)
SEL RTAC as controlled station, link address 64, common address 64
controlled stations at link addresses 78 and 20 (heard only)
a request of link status to link address 57 that no station answers
files.operations: class 2 polls and requests of link status of several link addresses, a double command (C_DC_NA_1, IOA 22003) as select and execute with confirmations and termination ("IEC 101 Select-Before-Operate sample")
files.missing_for_verification: the RTAC model and firmware, the controlling station, the stations at link addresses 78 and 20

files.format: pcapng, Ethernet, IPv4, TCP to serial port servers (2101, 2102, 50001)
files.evidence_basis: Recorded on the network of the distribution utility Energisa (file name, reporter): a controlling station on a Supermicro server (MAC 00:25:90) polls three serial lines through serial port servers of Digi International (00:40:9D) and Siemens Canada / RuggedCom (50:00:84). Physical serial lines; the controlled stations behind them are not identified.
systems: controlling station 192.150.52.11 (software not stated)
controlled stations at link addresses 7 and 12 behind Digi port server 192.150.52.4 (TCP 2102, 2101)
controlled station at link address 15 behind RuggedCom device 192.150.52.101 (TCP 50001)
files.operations: class 1 and class 2 polls only from the controlling station; the stations answer with M_SP_TA_1 (CP24Time2a), M_ME_NC_1 periodic and spontaneous, C_CS_NA_1 with cause spontaneous and C_TS_NA_1 with cause activation; about 70 s
files.privacy: private-range addresses of a utility network (192.150.52.0/24)
files.missing_for_verification: make, model and firmware of the controlled stations and of the controlling station
